blocking.finding: In MCP read-only mode, verify_completion still WRITES the COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar. `record_completion_verdict` emits the sidecar unconditionally (before the `sign` check), and the MCP call only disables signing via `sign=not _readonly()` — it has no way to suppress the sidecar. This violates the read-only guarantee and contradicts both the new docstring ('RECORDS ITS RESULT ON THE TICKET unless the server is read-only') and the claimed symmetry with review_plan, which passes `emit_sidecar=not ro` to suppress the sidecar entirely in read-only mode.
blocking.suggested_fix: Give record_completion_verdict a separate control for sidecar emission (e.g. an `emit_sidecar: bool = True` param) and pass `emit_sidecar=not _readonly()` from the MCP path, so read-only mode writes nothing.
